mapper.select: SELECT CONVERT(AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(USER_NAME), 'YUUM_SECURITY_KEY') USING UTF8) AS USER_NAME FROM USER_INFO WHERE USER_ID = #{P_USER_ID} AND USER_PASSWORD = SHA2(CONCAT(#{P_USER_PASSWORD}, UPDATE_DT, REG_DT ), 256);
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_ACCESS_HIS (USER_ID, EVENT_DT, ACCESS_TYPE, IP_ADDRESS, DEVICE_TYPE) VALUES (#{P_USER_ID}, CONVERT_TZ(NOW(3), @@GLOBAL.TIME_ZONE, 'ASIA/SEOUL'), #{P_ACCESS_TYPE}, #{P_IP_ADDRESS}, #{P_DEVICE_TYPE})
